etymologies.etymologyHTML: From play +‎ ground. Compare Middle English playstede (“playground”) from Old English pleġstede.

definitions.definition: (outdoors) A large open space for children to play in, usually having dedicated play equipment (such as swings and slides). [1780[1]]
(figuratively) Any physical or metaphysical space in which a person or organization has free rein to do as they please.
(programming) A sandbox for testing calls to an application programming interface.
